title: 494 million numbers
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Counts from Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct's own tensors (build/data/params_data.json, capture_params.py on Modal CPU).

blocks.text: This is the model we have been opening: 24 blocks, one on top of another. Every block is full of numbers. Let's count them.
blocks.say: This is the model we have been opening: twenty-four blocks, one on top of another. Every block is full of numbers. Let's count them.

blocks.text: Lift out the top block, and lay out what is inside. Each glass sheet is one weight matrix, at its real shape.
blocks.say: Lift out the top block, and lay out what is inside. Each glass sheet is one weight matrix, at its real shape.

blocks.text: Attention first. The query and output matrices are 896 by 896. Keys and values are thin, 896 by 128, because the fourteen heads share them.
blocks.say: Attention first. The query and output matrices are eight ninety-six by eight ninety-six. Keys and values are thin, eight ninety-six by one twenty-eight, because the fourteen heads share them.

blocks.text: Then the feed-forward part: gate, up and down, each 896 by 4,864. They hold most of the block. One block: almost 15 million numbers.
blocks.say: Then the feed-forward part: gate, up and down, each eight ninety-six by forty-eight sixty-four. They hold most of the block. One block: almost fifteen million numbers.

blocks.text: Times 24 blocks: 358 million. Add the embedding table, a row for every token in the vocabulary: 136 million more. In all, 494 million numbers.
blocks.say: Times twenty-four blocks: three hundred and fifty-eight million. Add the embedding table, a row for every token in the vocabulary: a hundred and thirty-six million more. In all, four hundred and ninety-four million numbers.

blocks.text: Look closer. Every cell is one number. The corner of block 24's query matrix: −0.0031, −0.0076, 0.0104.
blocks.say: Look closer. Every cell is one number. The corner of block twenty-four's query matrix: minus point zero zero three one, minus point zero zero seven six, point zero one zero four.

blocks.text: Every answer came from these numbers. Who chose them?
blocks.say: Every answer came from these numbers. Who chose them?
